why: The checkpoint under test was never trained on a valid content->token mapping. Its measured content-blindness is a property of its training target, not evidence about wave->text egress in principle.

finding_1_degenerate_target_salted_hash.defect: CPython hash() of str is SALTED per-process (PYTHONHASHSEED). The label->text mapping is not reproducible and cannot be inverted from the checkpoint.

finding_2_degenerate_target_random.rule: X_demo = F.normalize(torch.randn(batch_size, D)); a_target = torch.randint(0, vocab_size, ...)
finding_2_degenerate_target_random.defect: Waves and labels are BOTH random. There is no content->token correspondence in the training signal at all.

finding_3_path_ordered_removed.order: discrete BPE projection matrices, top-k logit sorts, and token unbinding heads removed from the LIVE path; classes and weights retained, live construction disabled
finding_3_path_ordered_removed.sites: 16 live construction sites in 14 files (AST-measured, receipt e6_d2_ast_sites.json)
finding_3_path_ordered_removed.consequence: The HENRINeuralEgressUnbinder is a DEFAULT-OFF, decision-removed discrete-token path.

coincidence_disclosure.variance: The two probes used different wave sets. I did NOT verify identical wave sets, so I record this as CORROBORATING, not conclusive. The mechanism conclusion rests on the training-target analysis, which stands on its own.

what_survives.ak5_arithmetic: unchanged and correct: real 0.5193 vs same-family shuffled 0.5501 (Q1 delta -0.031); margin 0.2175 vs 0.1709 (Q2 delta +0.047)
what_survives.d0_artifact_trained: true (rel_delta 1.007 / 1.146) -- it IS a trained artifact; it was trained on a degenerate target
what_survives.q4_wave_reaches_head: true (+0.201 / +0.265 / +0.284) -- wiring and signal path are live
what_survives.ak4_text_splice: unaffected; A-K4 measured a different mechanism and its PASS stands

what_does_NOT_survive.claim: that wave->text egress is falsified in principle
what_does_NOT_survive.reason: The instrument had no content->token mapping to recover. A readout trained on 35 salted-hash classes cannot carry compositional content by construction. This measurement cannot speak to a correctly-specified egress head.
what_does_NOT_survive.therefore: wave->text egress remains UNMEASURED, not FALSIFIED.

operator_named_defect_explained.operator_statement: wave-to-text egress currently yields top1_token_unique = 1 across 16 distinct waves
operator_named_defect_explained.explanation: Consistent with a 35-of-32000 class target under a salted hash. Collapse is the EXPECTED symptom of the degenerate target, not independent evidence of an architectural defect.

governance_note.conflict: The operator names wave-to-text egress as the governing A-K4/A-K5 target. Decision 2 (approved 2026-09-11) orders the discrete-token egress path removed from the live path.
governance_note.resolution: Latest operator instruction wins (recorded standing rule). Both records are preserved; neither is deleted.
governance_note.approval_required: Training a content-grounded unbinder is NEW scope and requires explicit operator approval.

next_correct_action.recommended: Train a minimal content-grounded egress head on the codec's own wave family with a valid token->text mapping (reproducible id assignment, full-context targets), then re-run the A-K5 gate with the same pre-registered Q1-Q4 and same-family content-destroyed control.
next_correct_action.rejected_first: Carrier-suppression residual probe. Rejected because a checkpoint with no content->token mapping has no content to suppress a carrier for; the probe would be motion.
next_correct_action.cost: local, $0 for the read-only analysis; training cost is separate and needs approval
next_correct_action.why_not_a_third_architecture: Two adjacent egress paths already failed specificity. A third untested architecture is motion, not progress.
